entities.name: 1863 Uprising & Muravyov's Repression
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: The January Uprising of 1863 in Lithuania, Sierakauskas's campaign, and the devastating repression by Governor-General Muravyov ('The Hangman'). The Latin alphabet ban (1864–1904), deportations to Siberia, and the destruction of the Polish-Lithuanian gentry's influence.
